claims.claim: USGS filmed lava spattering at fissure 18 around 02:00 HST on 16 May 2018.
claims.evidence_note: USGS May 16 video description identifies fissure 18, ~02:00 HST and authentic field audio.

claims.claim: Lower East Rift Zone eruptive fissures began May 3; USGS video near fissure 22 was captured overnight May 22 and posted May 24.
claims.evidence_note: USGS chronology describes May 3 initial eruption and May 24 video page specifies recording May 22.

claims.claim: Fissure 8 lava entered Kapoho Bay late June 3. USGS recorded the resulting ocean entry June 4 at 06:15 and 13:38.
claims.evidence_note: USGS notes entry by June 3 10:30 PM and its two compilation recordings on June 4.

claims.claim: A collapse/explosion event filmed at Kīlauea summit June 30 included rockfall and a small plume; magma withdrawal reduced support at summit.
claims.evidence_note: USGS footage description specifies June 30 at 14:51 HST; uploaded page July 2; explains magma drainage.
